start.title: [TODO:ru] Father's Favor
start.text:
[TODO:ru] You are Joseph. Father gave you a long coat of many colors.
Your brothers stare in silence.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Their faces darken. Hatred grows.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wear it humbly and thank Father
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You bow your head. "Thank you, Father."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Hide the coat to keep peace
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Father's gift cannot be hidden forever.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Bitter Glances
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] They turn away, muttering.
The coat feels heavier than before.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You return to him with quiet gratitude.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Father Notices
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Jacob asks where the gift has gone.
You cannot lie to him.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wear it openly and thank him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] He smiles. The coat is yours to bear.

thank_father.title: [TODO:ru] The Dream
thank_father.text:
[TODO:ru] That night you dream: eleven sheaves bow to yours.
You wake with the vision burning.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Honesty is the path. You go to them.
[TODO:ru] But God's words ask to be spoken.

secret_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] It Burns Inside
secret_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The dream returns each night.
You cannot hold it alone.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You walk to them at dawn.

tell_brothers.title: [TODO:ru] The Sheaves Bowed
tell_brothers.text:
[TODO:ru] "Your sheaves bowed to mine."
Their eyes flash. "Will you reign over us?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The dream is from God. You cannot unsay it.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stand firm — it is from God
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You hold your ground, calm and clear.

retract_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] The Dream Returns
retract_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Sun, moon and stars now bow to you.
God will not let you forget.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stand firm — it is from God
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You face them again, unshaken.

stand_firm.title: [TODO:ru] Father Sends You
stand_firm.text:
[TODO:ru] Jacob calls: "Go see if your brothers are well at Shechem."
They are far in the north.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A son obeys his father.
[TODO:ru] "Here am I," you answer.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send a servant in your place
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Father asked you, not another.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Jacob's Quiet Look
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Your father waits. He says nothing.
Obedience cannot be refused.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Obey and go to your brothers
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You take up your sandals.

servant_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] He Asked for You
servant_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The servant cannot bring back his sons.
Father asked for you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You shoulder the bundle and walk.

set_out.title: [TODO:ru] The Long Road
set_out.text:
[TODO:ru] The hills stretch on. Shechem is empty.
A stranger says: "They went to Dothan."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You came to find them. Press on.
[TODO:ru] You set your face north.

turnback_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] The Path Is Clear
turnback_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Father trusted you with this errand.
You cannot return empty-handed.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You turn north again.

to_dothan.title: [TODO:ru] They See You
to_dothan.text:
[TODO:ru] Across the green fields, your brothers spot the colored coat.
They gather, pointing.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Where can you run? The fields are open.
[TODO:ru] They have already seen it.
[TODO:ru] You raise your hand. "Peace, my brothers."

run_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Caught in the Field
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their long strides catch you.
The coat marks you from afar.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stand and greet them in peace
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You stop running and face them.

hide2_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Too Late
hide2_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] They are already coming.
The coat lies crumpled at your feet.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You walk forward, hands open.

approach.title: [TODO:ru] "The Dreamer Comes"
approach.text:
[TODO:ru] "Behold, this dreamer."
They seize you. The coat is torn from your shoulders.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Reuben's face softens. He speaks for you.
[TODO:ru] Your words make their hands tighter.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Fight back with all your strength
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Ten against one. You fall to the dust.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hands Like Iron
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their grip will not loosen.
Only mercy can save you now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You turn to the eldest. "Reuben—"

fight_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Pinned to the Earth
fight_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Bruised and breathless, you cannot rise.
Only Reuben might still hear you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] "Reuben, my brother — please."

beg_reuben.title: [TODO:ru] Reuben Intervenes
beg_reuben.text:
[TODO:ru] "Shed no blood," Reuben says. "Cast him into this pit."
He plans to rescue you later.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Cry out to Heaven from the pit
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] From the dark stones, you call on God.
[TODO:ru] Threats from a pit fall back on the speaker.

threat_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Stones Above
threat_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their laughter echoes down.
Only God can hear you here.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You whisper, "O God of my fathers..."

cry_out.title: [TODO:ru] Voices Above
cry_out.text:
[TODO:ru] Hooves and bells. Camels passing.
A caravan of Ishmaelites comes near.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stay silent and wait for Reuben
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Judah's voice rises before Reuben returns.
[TODO:ru] You wait. Above, Judah begins to speak.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] The Plan Unfolds
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] You hear Judah's voice — calm, calculating.
God is at work even now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You lift your eyes to the slit of sky.

judah_speaks.title: [TODO:ru] Judah's Counsel
judah_speaks.text:
[TODO:ru] "What profit if we kill our brother? Let us sell him."
They haul you up by the rope.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Silver has already been counted.
[TODO:ru] You bow your head. The road is His.
[TODO:ru] Bound hands cannot strike. Bound hearts can pray.

plead_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Twenty Pieces of Silver
plead_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Coins clink into Judah's hand.
The merchants nod and bind your wrists.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your tears are silent. Your trust is not.

strike_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Bound Wrists
strike_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The rope tightens. There is no fight to be had.
Only faith remains.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You whisper a prayer for them all.

accept.title: [TODO:ru] Toward Egypt
accept.text:
[TODO:ru] The caravan turns south, dust rising.
Behind you, your brothers grow small.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Carry the dream in your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The vision of sheaves remains, alive.

to_egypt.title: [TODO:ru] The Bloodied Coat
to_egypt.text:
[TODO:ru] Far behind, your brothers dip the coat in goat's blood.
They carry it home to Jacob.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] "Comfort him, O God of Israel."

father_grief.title: [TODO:ru] Jacob Mourns
father_grief.text:
[TODO:ru] Jacob tears his clothes. "A wild beast has devoured him."
He will not be comforted.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] What man means for evil, God means for good.

ending.title: [TODO:ru] The Road to Egypt
ending.text:
[TODO:ru] The dunes rise gold ahead.
A boy goes down to Egypt — but God goes with him.
